modmenu.descriptionTranslation.networkpr: A Minecraft mod with support for HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS5 proxies and per-server proxy configuration.
config.networkproxy.title: Network Proxy Settings
config.networkproxy.realms.mode.tooltip: Use the existing route, connect directly, or require a dedicated proxy.
Applies to joining Realms. Realms menus and account services keep their existing routes.
config.networkproxy.default_enabled.tool: Use the default proxy for web downloads such as resource packs.
config.networkproxy.enforce_proxy_all.to: Strictly require a proxy to join or ping any server, without a proxy, servers are not pingable.
config.networkproxy.address_enabled.tool: Require the configured proxy for joins and pings to this address.
Transfers from this server also require a proxy.
Server resource packs are downloaded via this proxy.
config.networkproxy.use_default_for_unli: Use the default proxy for servers without an address profile.
When off, unlisted servers connect directly or are blocked by enforcement.
config.networkproxy.resolve_hostnames_th: Resolve the server hostname via the specified proxy.
Skips local DNS and SRV lookups, even if the proxy fails.
When off, Minecraft can look up server hostnames locally and leak data.
config.networkproxy.invalid_proxy_host: Enter a hostname or IP address.
config.networkproxy.server_address.toolt: Enter a hostname or IP address.
config.networkproxy.server_address.legac: This import rule matches the hostname and its subdomains. After editing the address, it will use exact matching.
config.networkproxy.invalid_address: Enter a valid hostname or IP address.
config.networkproxy.duplicate_address: This server address is already configured.
